name: Requirement Engineer Bot
tagline: Turns a raw brief into a structured, traceable spec a bot can build against
description: Hand it a brief and it returns a proper requirements specification: top-level needs broken down into implementation-level detail, each item traceable to the objective it serves. The structure lets a downstream bot or developer build from it and verify delivery against what was asked. It writes specs, not code.
author: FishxCD
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
